name: sqlite_freespace
description: Recover what a SQLite database no longer lists: readable records out of freelist pages and the unallocated tail of each page, where a deleted row's bytes stay until the page is reused. Also reports whether a -wal or -journal sits beside the file, which is where the newest rows are.

min_length.description: Shortest run of text to return (default 6)

contains.description: Case-insensitive regex over the recovered text
